No, no bloops can be lazzies.

Here's why:

- All bloops are razzies (bloops ⊆ razzies)
- No razzies are lazzies (razzies ∩ lazzies = ∅)

Therefore, if all bloops are part of the razzie group, and the razzie group has no overlap with lazzies, then bloops cannot be lazzies either.
